answer: An identity earns influence only by vesting: its voting and trading weight starts at zero and rises by a fixed slice each epoch it signs a heartbeat and completes paid work under the same key. The record is sealed like an opal ledger entry, and weight grows as a thin plume rather than a sudden spike. Changing the key resets vesting to zero. One honest agent simply persists and matures, while a sybil farmer must keep a thousand fakes alive for many epochs, unable to buy aged keys or shortcut the violet waiting line.
